title: Work State Events Read Contract for Observe Source v1
description: Defines the subset of fields read by Observe's LegacyFrictionSource and WorkSource from .fgos/events.jsonl and .fgos/events/*.jsonl.

type.description: Work event type read by Observe readers.

ts.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the work event.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence number used for cursor tracking.

id.description: Work item ID associated with the event.

clear.description: Discovery verdict flag (read from work.discovery to determine clarify-pass settlement).

to.description: Target status (read from work.move: 'done' or 'wontfix' trigger settlement).

answer.description: Human answer string (read from work.move to trigger answer settlement).

from.description: Source step (read from work.step, or work.stage as written before the rename: leaving 'discovery' triggers clarify-pass settlement).
